directions.name: Field Manual
directions.description: Dense, editorial, information-forward. Hairline rules and spec-sheet motifs: inspection reports, AQL tables, and logistics data blocks act as the hero rather than decorative stats. Sharp edges, flat, no shadows. Full-bleed factory/QC photography. Monospace labels carry the spec data; oversized grotesque numerals anchor each section.
directions.rationale: The Guardian archetype made literal — it speaks compliance and standards to soothe the anxiety of importing from China, and matches the evidence-driven content guides exactly.

directions.name: The Atelier
directions.description: Generous whitespace with full-bleed atelier photography (fabric swatches, cutting tables, stitching detail). Oversized optical-serif display type for editorial authority. Warm bone + deep forest with brass pill CTAs. Overlapping image/text layers, soft rounded corners. The transformation story — sketch in, brand out.
directions.rationale: The Magician side — 'you bring a sketch, we deliver a brand.' The most direct translation of the premium references into a craft/studio framing.

directions.name: The Arena
directions.description: Dark, high-contrast, stadium energy. Oversized expanded-grotesque headlines in all-caps set against full-bleed action photography. One electric-lime accent used sparingly for CTA and key numbers. Tight grid, sharp edges, flat dark surfaces. Motion is a single orchestrated reveal on load.
directions.rationale: A sportswear brand — this direction reclaims the athletic identity and reads unmistakably premium activewear, while the B2B copy keeps it credible.

directions.name: The Blueprint
directions.description: Precise Swiss grid with hairline rules and a blueprint/technical-drawing motif. The 5-step 'how it works' process is the hero — each step rendered as a numbered spec with timeline + deliverable. Flat, structured, one strong accent (international blue) with red reserved for the CTA. Extremely organized, deadline-forward.
directions.rationale: Built for the League Logician and procurement manager — people who value consistency, timelines, and repeatability over flair. Process-as-hero answers their #1 question.

directions.name: The Concierge
directions.description: Warm, human, rounded. Real team photos (Wuhan office, QC inspectors) over soft sand backgrounds. Conversational, assured tone — 'we handle the mess, you handle the sales.' Rounded corners, subtle shadows, pill CTAs. Friendly but never fluffy; every claim carries a number.
directions.rationale: The anxiety-soothing side of the Guardian archetype for the FBA front-runner and influencer — buyers who fear importing from China and need a human, protective partner rather than a spec sheet.
